name: lc_mod_boathouse
note: our canal module "boathouse", canal and all, taken off the ring on 24 November (the owner: save it as a prefab): a smugglers' boat shed in the canal's left wall: a roll-up door, a slipway, a hatch to a cellar. Heads east from its anchor (the canal's middle at its entry, on the canal's floor). The module itself still builds: map_build.py module --name boathouse
